eos.reference: Converted from CoolProp n-Propane (identical Helmholtz coefficients).

viscosity.reference: Exact conversion of CoolProp n-Propane viscosity (published coefficients; max rel err 2.3e-07).

conductivity.reference: Exact conversion of CoolProp n-Propane conductivity (published coefficients; supercritical max rel err 8.8e-10; near-critical Olchowy-Sengers deviates up to 7.1e-03).
